THE POINT OF FORTUNA:
Fortuna is a sensitive point in a horoscope. It is arrived at by the longitudinal position of Lagna, MOON and SUN from 0° ARIES, as shown below:
Added together: 318° 06'
Deduct the position of the Sun from the added position of Lagna and Moon:
0° 28' Virgo is the point of Fortuna.\nAs the Lagna is Virgo at 19°45' the Fortuna falls in 12th Bhava.
Fortuna improves the matters of the house it occupies.
Benefic Planets forming good aspect with Fortuna will provide very good results are expected. If they form bad aspects, Unfavourable results will follow.
Malefic Planets forming good aspect with the Fortuna will indicate unfavorable results. If malefic planets form bad aspects to Fortuna, good results are indicated.
A person's fortune, its resources are clearly shown by the position of Fortuna. Therefore, it deserves serious attention. It shows only the financial position.
1) Matter related to Fortuna house will bring luck
2) All important life matters will bring luck if started on Fortuna day
Fortuna day:
5 Star = Sun and Moon are both on Fortuna star (Always New Moon Amavasya day)
4 Star = Sun in Fortuna star. Moon in any of the other two stars owned by the same Fortuna star lord
3 Star = Sun in any of the other two stars owned by the same Fortuna star lord and Moon in Fortuna star
2 Star = Sun and Moon in any of the other two stars owned by the same Fortuna star lord
1 Star = Sun not in any of the three stars owned by Fortuna Star lord. Moon in Fortuna star.
